cli.help.main:
Chimera — bypass blocks from the command line.

Usage:
  chimera <command> [action] [parameters]
  chimera --window | --browser          open the window or a browser tab

Commands:
{commands}

Common parameters (can go anywhere):
  --json           machine output: {"schema": 1, "ok": …, "command": …, "level": …, "data": …}
  --show-secrets   show links and secrets (hidden by default)
  --lang ru|en     output language (by default from the settings, see `chimera lang show`)
  -h, --help       this help; `chimera <command> --help` for help on a command
  --version        version

Exit codes:
{codes}

More: `chimera docs` (commands, folder layout, --json format).

Menu
  ↑↓ / W S     select an item
  Enter / D    open a section
  Esc / A      return to the menu
  1–9          open a section by number

Inside sections
  ↑↓ / W S     table rows, choices or form controls
  ←→ / A D     columns in the lists table
  Tab          next form control
  Shift+Tab    previous form control
  Enter        select / apply
  Space        toggle / mark
  /            search strategies
  e            edit a list in an external editor
  x            stop bypass
  r            reset adapter DNS to DHCP
  Delete       remove an app

WASD and digits type normally inside input fields.
? — help. Q — close TUI; Chimera keeps running.
Secrets and proxy links are hidden.
  Ctrl+T       try selected settings
  Ctrl+K       keep trial settings
  Ctrl+R       revert trial settings
